lines.text: Market day. Eleven thousand crossings. One exit road each end.
I want a drill. Five minutes. Marked exits, marked timing. The guild says it costs a day's trade.
How long to clear the span?
Eleven minutes. If the load is even.
You know the number. Good. Plan the drill, tell the guild it is fine, or stand on the weakest span. Your call. I will log it.
